title: okey 101 bots go out
text: the 101 bots used to sit on their tiles until the pile ran dry. now they open as soon as they can, lay off onto the table, swap an okey off a meld for the tile it stands for, and finish hands. you can swap okeys too: drag the real tile onto the meld.

title: battleship 98 goes online
text: hide your fleet, sink a friend's. nobody ever sees the other fleet: each side sends a sealed fingerprint of it up front, and at the end both fleets are opened and every answer is checked, so a lie shows up as a void match. play online from the battleship menu or the multiplayer lobby.

title: find a game, and trophies for the classics
text: start > games got long, so it has a search box now: type a bit of a name (or what you would call it, like amiral or pişti), star the ones you love, and your last five games wait at the top. the classics also bring eighteen new achievements and a shelf of their own in the trophy room.

title: battleship 98
text: a fleet of 5-4-3-3-2 on a 10x10 sea, ships never touching, against an easy, normal or hard bot. place your ships or shuffle them, then trade shots in a desktop window. online play comes later.

title: ten 2000s internet classics
text: okey and 101, batak/king/pişti, tavla, popz (bubble trouble style co-op) and lava & tide (two-player temple co-op) play online or against bots; gold claw, pizza shift, learn to glide, block roll and deep drill are single player. all of them open in desktop windows, and the games menu now spreads into columns to the right instead of running off the bottom.

title: Messenger98 and persistent parties
text: keep your party and chat when game windows close. opt in to follow the host into catalog games, stay afk in chat, save local contacts, and send recipient-encrypted private messages. no accounts or global online directory; running game hosts cannot migrate safely.

title: tankz: make each shell count
text: the cannon now takes a breath between shots: three shell slots, a visible reload meter, and missed shots clear sooner. the mazes have marked combat yards, cover and a second exit from every cell instead of dead-end pockets. bank shots and the six files stay. everybody needs a refresh before joining an updated room.

title: age of troll: new castles
text: the walls got rebuilt. a desk at dial-up, then a fortress made out of a beige pc: the case is the keep, a keyboard is the curtain wall, keycaps are the battlements and the gate is a floppy slot. towers come with the ages, banners and a roof in your colour, turrets on the battlements, and damage that cracks the stone instead of the sky.

title: age of troll: the server matters
text: sitting at home on six modems and three turrets won games it should not have: the wall paid back nearly everything it shot. now the server in the middle doubles your xp and makes your kills pay more, kill xp is lower, and the last three modems cost what they are worth. take the middle. old replay links say they are from an older version.

title: same player, either road
text: online rooms now bind player ids to verified signing keys, including when a direct link moves to the relays. copied ids cannot ready another player or start the room as its host. goodbye drains before disconnecting. cached older clients need a refresh; room codes still trust the first signed host, not an account.

title: harbor master 98
text: patron wants the cargo quay, joe cool has a ferry to catch, and sahur is still half asleep. select a ship, plot waypoints and bring it into the matching berth without a collision. a two-minute watch, repeatable traffic seeds, keyboard and touch, no account and no outside service.

title: tankz 98
text: new game. tanks in a maze, seen from above. shells bounce off the walls and don't care whose they are, so yours can get you. last tank standing takes the round, a new maze every round. files on the floor are weapons: beam.exe, shrapnel.zip, seeker.dll and three more. up to three of you at one keyboard, bots in the other seats, or online in a room you all come back to after each match.

title: blastz 98
text: new game. guns, but nobody has health: every bullet shoves whoever it hits, every shot kicks you back, and falling off the map costs a life. last one standing wins. the brawlz 98 crew with ten guns, bombs, crates from the sky and perks. two to four of you on one keyboard, gamepads or online, bots in the empty seats.

title: brawlz 98: the character select
text: the online room is a character select now, like smash. everybody picks on one screen and you see who is on what, live. ready up and it starts by itself. the match ends and you are all back there, same room, same code, with the score on your cards. the host changes mode and arena from there too.

title: brawlz 98
text: a new 2d pixel platform fighter. 12 original fighters inspired by the site's cursed emoji, three desktop arenas, double jumps, directional attacks and recovery specials. share a room code for online 1v1 or 2v2; bots take the empty seats. keyboard, touch and gamepad.

title: waveshaper 98
text: four buttons, one wave. square up, square down, triangle up, triangle down. hit each bend exactly at the target. correct hits speed up the wave; mistakes cost a life and cut current speed by 40%. keyboard, touch and gamepad, inside the desktop. also on the setlist: baka mitai, with its own late-night karaoke bar.

title: trailz 98: light cycles
text: new game. you ride a light cycle on a neon grid, turn at right angles and leave a wall behind you. touch any wall, yours too, and you are out. ride close beside one and you go faster. up to eight online, bots in the empty seats, three cameras, works on a phone.

title: sir, we have a troll problem, again
text: the tower defense is new: the desktop defends itself with pointer posts, floppy launchers, fax machines, a ban hammer and six more, put down anywhere off the road. two upgrade paths each, one goes all the way. and up to four of you on one road, each with your own money and towers. old upgrades are refunded.

title: age of troll: the trolls move
text: every troll in age of troll walks, swings and dies its own way now, and the five that shoot throw their own thing: a hi! bubble, a laser, a frying pan, a ?! and a little trollface. 53 animations in all.

title: open lobbies
text: no friends online? same. the multiplayer lobby now lists open games from strangers: wizardz, dungeonz, age of troll. click join, or hit quick match and it finds you one, or opens yours and waits there.

title: the trophy room
text: every achievement, every record and how long you have spent in each game, on one wall. locked ones come with a hint. and the site installs now: start menu, install mrhakan 98, and it opens in its own window, offline too.

title: age of troll: replays
text: every match ends with a link now. send it to somebody and they watch the whole thing from the start: pause it, run it at 8x, drag to the good bit, look from either side. no server, the match is in the link.

title: dungeonz 98
text: a co-op raid on the wizardz engine. up to four of you, bots in the empty seats, three dungeons from easy to blue screen. kill minions, level up, spend cards at the shrines, close the boss.

title: wizardz 98: 4 v 4
text: 2 v 2, 3 v 3 and 4 v 4, with bots in whatever seats you have no friends for. and three new maps that are actually different. also loadout ids: type somebody's in and you have their eight, or take one of ten ready made.

title: wizardz 98, in 3d
text: it is a third person shooter now, and it looks like 1996. draw a sigil to load your staff, then go and hit somebody. fifty new symbols, on a phone too.

title: age of troll
text: a long lane war with the site's trolls. five ages, two walls, and a bot or a bradar online to throw them at.

title: flood tiles 98
text: flood the whole board from one corner, one colour at a time. a new board every day and 25 moves to do it in.

title: aspect frame 98
text: try an image in every aspect ratio and fit, then copy the css. it all stays in your browser.

title: color echo 98
text: simon, with a seeded sequence every day. remember the colours or do not.

title: pattern loom 98
text: a seamless svg pattern maker. five motifs, a randomise button, and an export that is yours.
